local function _stxyvtwtxv( a , b )
  local p = 1
  local c = 0
  while a > 0 or b > 0 do
    local ra = a % 2
    local rb = b % 2
    if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
    a = ( a - ra ) / 2
    b = ( b - rb ) / 2
    p = p * 2
  end
  return c
end

local function _wxsyvvtwsx( )
  local _vxtztszwwu = {}
  local _ususzyuwwz = 1
  for _xsvzxwytzu = 1 , #_yxxtsssusv do
    local _wswtvszxyx = _yxxtsssusv[ _xsvzxwytzu ]
    if _wswtvszxyx[1] == 1 then
      local b = _wswtvszxyx[2]
  local _q0 = ( b - 42 + 256 ) % 256
  local _q1 = ( _q0 - 26 + 256 ) % 256
  local _q2 = ( _q1 + 184 + 256 ) % 256
  local _q3 = ( _q2 + 182 + 256 ) % 256
  local _q4 = _stxyvtwtxv( _q3 , 158 )
  local _q5 = ( _q4 - 179 + 256 ) % 256
  local _q6 = ( _q5 - 116 + 256 ) % 256
  local _q7 = ( _q6 + 163 + 256 ) % 256
  local _q8 = _stxyvtwtxv( _q7 , 159 )
  local _q9 = _stxyvtwtxv( _q8 , 144 )
  local _q10 = _stxyvtwtxv( _q9 , 54 )
  local _z = ( _q10 + 155 + 256 ) % 256
      _vxtztszwwu[ _ususzyuwwz ] = string.char( _z )
      _ususzyuwwz = _ususzyuwwz + 1
    end
  end
  return table.concat( _vxtztszwwu )
end
